One family, one unit

A family of actors trained at Indian Films Academy, run by their own teacher. PICHCHRAPA is this family's studio.

What makes it special: the actors are also the writers, the directors, the editors, the DI colourists and the music-makers. At the moment no outside person is brought in for any of the work.

This platform exists so that after learning acting, no artist has to run from door to door or beg for work. They stand on their own feet, make their own work and show it to the world.

Yogesh Chaitanya
Founder, PICHCHRAPA and Indian Films Academy
